en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The moving (briskly) in the valley of Muhassar is of one hundred steps’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Muhammad ibn ‘Isma‘il who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Moving in Wadiy Muhassar is for one hundred steps.’”
